entities.name: Olivia Voldaren
entities.description: A vampire native to Innistrad and progenitor of the Voldaren bloodline.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: Plane of gothic horror where Olivia lives.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: Planeswalker and vampire who seeks Olivia's help against Nahiri.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: Planeswalker who wars against Sorin and defeats him.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: Angel beloved by Sorin, killed at Olivia's request.

entities.name: Thalia
entities.description: Leader of a fleet who allies temporarily with Olivia at Thraben.

entities.name: Seeta
entities.description: Leader of the Sinpurged, killed by Olivia.

entities.name: Arlinn Kord
entities.description: Planeswalker and werewolf who tries to halt the Eternal Night.

entities.name: Katilda
entities.description: Spirit tied to the Moonsilver Key, held hostage by Olivia.

entities.name: Moonsilver Key
entities.description: Artifact Olivia wants in order to control Innistrad's angels.

entities.name: Edgar Markov
entities.description: Elder vampire whom Olivia charms and plans to marry.

entities.name: Sigarda
entities.description: Archangel captured by Olivia and later freed by Katilda.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: Planeswalker of the Gatewatch who breaks Olivia's hold on her geists.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: Group of planeswalkers who raid Voldaren Manor.

entities.name: Tovolar
entities.description: Werewolf packmate of Arlinn held back from attacking Edgar.

entities.name: Voldaren Manor
entities.description: Site of Olivia's wedding and the Gatewatch raid.

entities.name: Thunder Junction
entities.description: Plane where Olivia settles to create new alliances.

entities.name: Battle of Thraben
entities.description: Battle in which Innistrad's residents make a last stand.

entities.name: Shilgengar's Ritual
entities.description: Ritual in which Olivia drank angel blood and became a vampire.

entities.name: Marycz
entities.description: Angel whose blood was drained by Edgar Markov.

events.summary: Olivia drinks the angel Marycz's blood in Shilgengar's Ritual and becomes an immortal vampire.
events.quote: This turned her into an immortal vampire .

events.summary: Sorin recruits Olivia against Nahiri; she requires that he kill Avacyn, and they raise a vampire army.
events.quote: Sorin and Olivia assembled a vampire army and went to war against Nahiri.

events.summary: Nahiri defeats Sorin and encases him in stone; Olivia proclaims herself lord of Innistrad and takes his sword.
events.quote: Olivia proclaimed herself the new lord of Innistrad and took his sword from him.

events.summary: Olivia agrees to a truce with Thalia at Thraben and kills Seeta in front of her.
events.quote: Olivia killed Seeta - the Leader of the Sinpurged, right in front of Thalia.

events.summary: Olivia holds Katilda hostage and takes the Moonsilver Key from Arlinn's party.
events.quote: Olivia swept down from the skies and held Katilda hostage, demanding the Moonsilver Key from the assembled party.

events.summary: Olivia charms Edgar with her blood so he agrees to marry her, planning to control Innistrad's angels with Sigarda's blood.
events.quote: Olivia used her blood to wake Edgar from his sleep and, in doing so, managed to charm him.

events.summary: Sorin attacks during the wedding; Katilda frees Sigarda, whose outburst shatters the glass and wounds guests.
events.quote: Katilda used her powers to free Sigarda from her prison.

events.summary: The Gatewatch raids the manor; Olivia flees and impales Arlinn.
events.quote: Sigarda's outburst lowered the wards around Voldaren Manor, allowing the Gatewatch to begin their raid.

events.summary: Olivia drops the Moonsilver Key in defeat and escapes with Edgar.
events.quote: Olivia dropped the Moonsilver Key in defeat and escaped with Edgar through one of the broken windows.

events.summary: Olivia settles on Thunder Junction and becomes a queen of deadly subjects.
events.quote: Olivia once more became a queen of hungry and deadly subjects.

relations.note: enlisted by him against Nahiri, then betrays him
relations.quote: Sorin enlisted her help, and she cannot allow Nahiri's revenge.

In his confused state, the elder vampire agreed to marry her.
Olivia was beset by Arlinn, who was searching for the Key
the two agreed to a temporary truce
